+    // 数据缓存策略
+    const cacheStrategy = {
+      set: function(key, data, expire = 3600) {
+        const cacheData = {
+          data,
+          expire: Date.now() + expire * 1000
+        };
+        wx.setStorageSync(key, JSON.stringify(cacheData));
+      },
+      get: function(key) {
+        const cacheData = wx.getStorageSync(key);
+        if (!cacheData) return null;
+        
+        const { data, expire } = JSON.parse(cacheData);
+        if (Date.now() > expire) {
+          wx.removeStorageSync(key);
+          return null;
+        }
+        return data;

+    ```javascript
+    // 日期处理工具示例
+    const dateUtils = {
+      formatDate: function(date) {
+        const year = date.getFullYear();
+        const month = (date.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
+        const day = date.getDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
+        return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
+      },
+      
+      getWeekRange: function(date) {
+        const startDate = new Date(date);
+        const day = startDate.getDay();
+        startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - day);
+        
+        const endDate = new Date(startDate);
+        endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + 6);
+        
+        return {
+          start: this.formatDate(startDate),
+          end: this.formatDate(endDate)
+        };
+      }
+    };
+    ```
  
  2. taskUtils
-    - 任务统计

+    ```javascript
+    // 任务工具示例
+    const taskUtils = {
+      validateTask: function(task) {
+        if (!task.title) return '请输入任务名称';
+        if (!task.date) return '请选择执行日期';
+        if (task.type === 'study' && !task.startTime) return '请选择开始时间';
+        if (task.type === 'study' && !task.endTime) return '请选择结束时间';
+        return null;
+      },
+      
+      calculateDuration: function(startTime, endTime) {
+        const [startHours, startMinutes] = startTime.split(':').map(Number);
+        const [endHours, endMinutes] = endTime.split(':').map(Number);
+        
+        const startTotalMinutes = startHours * 60 + startMinutes;
+        const endTotalMinutes = endHours * 60 + endMinutes;
+        
+        return endTotalMinutes - startTotalMinutes;
+      }
+    };
+    ```

+      const { startDate, endDate } = e.detail;
+      
+      // 如果选择了本周或本月，且没有设置开始日期，则使用当天作为开始日期
+      const today = this.data.dateNow;
+      const finalStartDate = startDate || today;
+      
+      // 确保开始日期不早于当天
+      if (finalStartDate < today) {
+        console.log('[TaskEdit] 开始日期早于当天，自动调整为当天');
+        this.setData({
+          'task.repeat.startDate': today,
+          'task.repeat.endDate': endDate
+        });
+      } else {
+        this.setData({
+          'task.repeat.startDate': finalStartDate,
+          'task.repeat.endDate': endDate
+        });
+      }
+    }
+    ```
+ 
+ 2. 性能优化
+    ```javascript
+    // 组件渲染优化
+    Component({
+      options: {
+        addGlobalClass: true,
+        multipleSlots: true
+      },
+      properties: {
+        data: {
+          type: Object,
+          observer: function(newVal) {
+            this.debounceUpdate(newVal);
+          }
+        }
+      },
+      methods: {
+        debounceUpdate: debounce(function(data) {
+          this.setData({ processedData: this.processData(data) });
+        }, 300)
+      }
+    });
+    ```
+ 
+ 3. 数据缓存优化
+    ```javascript
+    // 数据缓存策略
+    const cacheStrategy = {
+      set: function(key, data, expire = 3600) {
+        const cacheData = {
+          data,
+          expire: Date.now() + expire * 1000
+        };
+        wx.setStorageSync(key, JSON.stringify(cacheData));
+      },
+      get: function(key) {
+        const cacheData = wx.getStorageSync(key);
+        if (!cacheData) return null;
+        
+        const { data, expire } = JSON.parse(cacheData);
+        if (Date.now() > expire) {
+          wx.removeStorageSync(key);
+          return null;
+        }
+        return data;
+      }
+    };
+    ```

+ 
+ 2. 性能优化
+    ```javascript
+    // 组件渲染优化
+    Component({
+      options: {
+        addGlobalClass: true,
+        multipleSlots: true
+      },
+      properties: {
+        data: {
+          type: Object,
+          observer: function(newVal) {
+            this.debounceUpdate(newVal);
+          }
+        }
+      },
+      methods: {
+        debounceUpdate: debounce(function(data) {
+          this.setData({ processedData: this.processData(data) });
+        }, 300)
+      }
+    });
+    ```
+ 
+ 3. 数据缓存优化
+    ```javascript
+    // 数据缓存策略
+    const cacheStrategy = {
+      set: function(key, data, expire = 3600) {
+        const cacheData = {
+          data,
+          expire: Date.now() + expire * 1000
+        };
+        wx.setStorageSync(key, JSON.stringify(cacheData));
+      },
+      get: function(key) {
+        const cacheData = wx.getStorageSync(key);
+        if (!cacheData) return null;
+        
+        const { data, expire } = JSON.parse(cacheData);
+        if (Date.now() > expire) {
+          wx.removeStorageSync(key);
+          return null;
+        }
+        return data;
+      }
+    };
+    ```
```
